items.headline: Washington's offense shows up late with Williams and Lawson teaming up to beat Nebraska 17-10
items.description: — Chris Lawson scored the go-ahead touchdown on a 25-yard catch-and-run with 1:30 left and Alex McLaughlin returned Anthony Colandrea's third interception of the game 48 yards for the clinching score as Washington came from behind to beat Nebraska...

items.headline: Nebraska QB Anthony Colandrea re-signs for 2027 season, agent says
items.description: Nebraska quarterback Anthony Colandrea has signed a deal to return to the Cornhuskers in 2027 for his final year of college eligibility, his agent told ESPN.
